title: Zen Path quickstart hero & step gesture assets
creator: Asha Patel
description: Refresh the quickstart landing assets with a lightweight, developer-focused hero and a set of step-gesture diagrams that scale across breakpoints. Deliverables: hero composition (desktop/tablet/mobile), 3 staged step diagrams that explain onboarding flow, motion-safe micro-animations (Lottie + reduced-motion fallbacks), a screenshot capture pipeline for release screenshots, and an asset handoff package (SVGs, optimized PNGs, Figma spec). The intent is to improve clarity for engineering users, reduce first-contentful-paint impact, and make screenshots reproducible for release notes.
acceptance_criteria: Hero composition approved and exported at 3 breakpoints (desktop, tablet, mobile)
Three step-gesture diagrams created with accessible color contrast and semantic labels
Motion variants: Lottie animation + CSS reduced-motion fallback documented
Screenshot pipeline defined with automated capture instructions and naming convention
Design tokens and asset sizes documented for engineering handoff (SVG primaries, 2x/3x PNG fallbacks)
Final assets uploaded to team Design Drive and linked in PR for front-end integration
design_refs: Brand guidelines: neutral palette + accent-emerald for CTA
decisions: Use a left-aligned hero composition with a single prominent CTA to mirror developer mental model of 'get started'
Prefer SVGs for illustrations to keep bundle size low; provide optimized PNG fallbacks for older email templates
Animations will be authored in Lottie; reduced-motion flag will switch to fade-in PNGs to respect accessibility settings
Three-step diagrams will use numbered micro-steps with clear affordances (icon + one-line caption) instead of full paragraph copy
tradeoffs: Trade-off between screenshot freshness and visual consistency: we will snapshot a stable release candidate and regenerate only for major UI changes
Using SVGs reduces raster fidelity in some email clients; we will include 2x PNG exports for email where needed
Heavier hero animations improve perceived polish but hurt FCP; prioritized minimal motion and deferred loading for non-critical Lottie assets
tasks: Finalize hero frames and responsive layout in Figma
Create Lottie animation and export reduced-motion variants
Define screenshot capture script and naming convention in screenshot-pipeline-readme.md
Run an accessibility pass for contrast and keyboard focus for diagrams
Prepare engineering handoff PR with asset links and CSS layout guidance
